cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ready to roll, just as the mechanic said. Enjoy your afternoon off; I'll bring your bike home for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asked whether the rim rolls straight. The frame's still at the other shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Straight, yes. I'll collect the parts in order. You stay with your book.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The wheel shop closes at three. The frame isn't ready until four.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll do the wheel first and wait for the frame. Keep your afternoon; I'll bring the whole thing home instead of bothering you with separate collections.
